name: bmkg
description: BMKG open data (no API key): latest, M5.0+ and felt earthquakes, 3-day village weather forecasts by adm4 code, nowcast weather warnings (credit BMKG as the source)

nodes.title: Latest earthquake
nodes.description: The most recent earthquake BMKG reported in Indonesia: time (WIB and UTC DateTime), coordinates, magnitude, depth, region, tsunami potential, felt intensity (MMI) and shakemap_url. Source: BMKG (Badan Meteorologi, Klimatologi, dan Geofisika); credit BMKG when showing it

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Recent M5.0+ earthquakes
nodes.description: The last 15 earthquakes of magnitude 5.0 or more in and around Indonesia, newest first, with tsunami potential. Source: BMKG (Badan Meteorologi, Klimatologi, dan Geofisika); credit BMKG when showing it

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Recent felt earthquakes
nodes.description: The last 15 earthquakes people felt (any magnitude), newest first, with where and how strongly (MMI scale) they were felt. Source: BMKG (Badan Meteorologi, Klimatologi, dan Geofisika); credit BMKG when showing it

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Village weather forecast
nodes.description: 3-day weather forecast for one village/kelurahan (Kemendagri adm4 code, e.g. 31.71.03.1001 Kemayoran) in 3-hour steps: temperature t (°C), humidity hu (%), weather_desc/weather_desc_en, wind ws (km/h) and wd, cloud cover tcc (%), rain tp (mm), visibility vs_text, local_datetime. Source: BMKG (Badan Meteorologi, Klimatologi, dan Geofisika); credit BMKG when showing it

adm4.description: Village (adm4) code from Kemendagri No. 100.1.1-6117/2022, e.g. 31.71.03.1001

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Active weather warnings
nodes.description: Active nowcast weather warnings (heavy rain, thunderstorms, strong wind) per province, with each warning's alert_code for get_weather_warning. Source: BMKG (Badan Meteorologi, Klimatologi, dan Geofisika); credit BMKG when showing it

language.description: Warning text language: id (Indonesian) or en (English)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Weather warning details
nodes.description: One nowcast warning (CAP): event, urgency, severity, certainty, effective/expires times, affected districts, infographic URL and optionally the area polygons. Source: BMKG (Badan Meteorologi, Klimatologi, dan Geofisika); credit BMKG when showing it

language.description: Warning text language: id (Indonesian) or en (English)

include_polygons.description: Also return the area polygons as [latitude, longitude] pairs (large)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: BMKG open data request
nodes.description: Call any BMKG open data endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/DataMKG/TEWS/autogempa.json". Only the API's own host is allowed.

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/DataMKG/TEWS/autogempa.json"
